name: openutau-chiaki
description: Write, edit and render singing with OpenUtau Chiaki and its DiffSinger voicebanks.
long_description: Connects to the MCP server inside an installed OpenUtau Chiaki. An agent can create a project, add and edit notes and lyrics, pick a phonemizer, tune pitch and render audio, either on its own or on the project open in the app. OpenUtau Chiaki must be installed first.

cli_path.title: OpenUtau.Cli location
cli_path.description: Only needed when OpenUtau Chiaki is not installed in its usual place: the OpenUtau.Cli file next to the app's executable.

gui.title: Work on the project open in the app
gui.description: Edits show live in OpenUtau Chiaki, which must be running with agent access turned on. Off: the agent works on its own project without a window.
